Voice.// Notes: Single source of truth lives in ContactCenterAgent.Shared.VoiceLive.VoiceLiveDefaults. Production now runs Christel HD Omni with style='friendly' (picked from the 5-mood judge A/B — see .github/prompts/try-moods.prompt.md). To revert to standard neural, set Name to 'da-DK-ChristelNeural' (Temperature/Style will be auto-omitted from the wire payload). EndpointId only matters for azure-custom voices.
Voice.Name: da-DK-Christel:DragonHDOmniLatestNeural
Voice.// Temperature: Sent only when Name is HD/HD Omni (contains ':DragonHD'). For standard neural this value is omitted from the wire payload.
Voice.// Style: mstts:express-as style. Lab-verified to audibly affect da-DK HD Omni despite docs claiming English-only. Sent only on HD voices. Set to empty string to opt out.
Voice.// Locale: ENFORCES TTS locale (RealtimeAzureStandardVoice.locale). Without this the voice can drift toward a generic Scandinavian / Swedish accent on English loanwords. Inherits 'da-DK' from VoiceLiveDefaults; set to empty string here to opt out.

VoiceLive.// Notes: Mirrors danish-voice-lab defaults. Spec defaults: Threshold=0.5, PrefixPaddingMs=300, SilenceDurationMs=500, InterruptResponse=true.

Vad.// Threshold: Speech-detection probability 0.0-1.0. 0.3 matches console; raise toward 0.7 only if PSTN background noise causes false barge-ins.
Vad.// PrefixPaddingMs: Audio buffered BEFORE the speech-onset point.
Vad.// SilenceDurationMsOther: End-of-turn silence for non-English callers (Danish etc.). Matches danish-voice-lab (the console sandbox tuned by ear). Bumping this slows EVERY turn — only raise if false barge-ins on number-reading become a real problem.
Vad.// InterruptResponse: If true, caller speech immediately stops the bot mid-sentence (barge-in).

Transcription.// Notes: Azure Speech (da-DK). Norlys phrase_list now lives in code/shared/ContactCenterAgent.Shared (NorlysDanishPhrases) so caller-agent and danish-voice-lab share one vocabulary list. Override here only if you need to A/B test a different list.
